planning-artifacts.cue: Use when recording or updating the accepted specification and implementation tickets.

domain-modeling.cue: Use when the project agrees on shared terms or an important architecture decision.
Use when recording an accepted domain term or architecture decision.

interface-design.cue: Load when the planning decision requires choosing the interface's visual direction, layout, or interaction design. A prototype with an incidental interface does not trigger this procedure.

prototype.cue: Use when a small runnable prototype can settle a planning decision.

research.cue: Use for a bounded investigation that benefits from dedicated research.

wayfinding.cue: Use when there are too many open decisions to track reliably in conversation.
Use when creating or updating a decision map or decision ticket.

tracking.cue: My request selects or changes the project tracker.

delegate.cue: Use when a task can be assigned separately and benefits from fresh context.

interface-design.cue: Use when agreed work creates or substantially changes an interface.

research.cue: Use for a bounded investigation needed by the implementation.

testing.cue: Write a failing test before changing behavior and keep focused regression tests.

documentation.cue: Update documentation affected by the implementation.

review.cue: Review the validated work against the request and look for engineering problems.

commit.cue: Commit all completed changes, grouped by result.
